root.title: United Nations General Assembly
root.infoDescription: Follow the United Nations agenda through resolutions, the Security Council, and country votes. Participation and decisions can affect global policy and your country's diplomatic standing.
root.electionInfo: Information about the election of non-permanent Security Council members

common.voteProgress: Voting time remaining: {remaining} days (30 days - {elapsed} days)
common.cooldown: Removal cooldown: {count} days remaining (will be removed automatically)
common.noCountries: There are no countries in this list yet.
common.targetHint: Choose a continent, then select your target country.

resolution.warBanDesc: Warfare between countries is prohibited worldwide for the selected period.
resolution.armsEmbargoDesc: Arms trading is prohibited for the selected period.
resolution.economicEmbargoDesc: Industrial and non-gold mining production, and non-gold income, fall by 60% for the selected period.
resolution.invasionDesc: Allows a country to be invaded without condemnation by other countries.
resolution.productionBanDesc: Production of the selected product is halted for the selected period.
resolution.productHint: Choose a product from the country's production sectors.
resolution.productHelp: Selecting a product opens the production sectors and products list.
resolution.createHint: Start by proposing a draft resolution for member countries to discuss.

council.actionMilitaryDesc: Armies from all countries unite to attack the selected country.
council.actionEconomicDesc: While active, manufacturing, livestock, agriculture, fishing, food processing, and non-gold mining production decrease by 50%.
council.actionNavalDesc: While active, manufacturing, livestock, agriculture, fishing, food processing, and non-gold mining production decrease by 25%.
council.actionFullDesc: For the selected period, this country cannot sign contracts or trade.
council.actionAidDesc: Provides resources and logistical support to the selected country.
council.createHint: Propose a draft resolution for UN Security Council members to discuss.
council.militaryBanMessage: Military invasions cannot be proposed while a global war ban is active.
council.vetoLimited: Use one limited veto during the term

election.title: UN Security Council Non-Permanent Member Election
election.details: {year} election — Cohort {cohort} — 5 seats this year — 2-year term
election.activeMembers: 10 non-permanent members serve at a time; 5 seats rotate each year.
election.location: June · UN Headquarters, New York · UN General Assembly
election.contributionNote: Peacekeeping and UN aid contribution scores are tracked through campaign actions because country profiles lack separate historical metrics for them.
election.loadError: Country profiles failed to load. Reopen the Security Council menu and try again.
election.vetoSyncError: Veto status could not be synchronized.
election.saveError: Election results could not be saved to game storage.
election.voteIncomplete: Voting cannot be completed yet. Make sure nominations and campaigning have started.
election.voterProfilesError: Election stopped: profiles are required for all 193 members; only {count} matched.
election.memberCountError: Only {count} UN members were recognized, not 193. Voting is unavailable.
election.profileMatchError: Qualification data matched only {count} of 193 UN member profiles.
election.notMember: The country you are playing is not a sovereign UN member and cannot nominate or vote.
election.nextSchedule: The next election is scheduled for June {year}. Nominations run June 1–14, campaigns June 15–24, voting June 25–30, and results are announced June 30.
election.nominationSchedule: Nominations are open through June 14. Campaigning starts automatically on June 15.
election.votingSchedule: Voting starts automatically today; official results are scheduled for June 30.
election.winners: Elected members — term January 1, {startYear} to December 31, {endYear}
election.playerReward: Your country gains +25 diplomatic reputation and +15 permanent soft power; UN voting influence rises 50% during the term.
election.memberDuty: Members must Support, Reject, or Abstain on every resolution during their term. Not voting reduces diplomatic reputation by 1 point.
